____________________________________________________ Sandeep Sharma, Judge(oral):
By way of instant petition, petitioner has prayed for following relief:-
"(i) That necessary order, direction and writ may please be issued thereby directing the respondent Nos. 1 to 4 to take appropriate safety and protection measures to protect the land and house property of the petitioner comprising Khasra No.
1377/1279/1100 and 1379/1283/ 1101, Kitas 2, measuring 00-01-13 hectares, situated in mohal Gharyana, Tehsil Suni, District Shimla, H.P., thereby protecting the aforesaid property from submergence into the reservoir and further to Whether the reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
protect the same from damage, caused due to swampy land.

(ii) To pass necessary order, direction and writ thereby directing the respondent No.2 to grant just .
compensation to the petitioner on account of the damage and loss caused to his land and house property besides the mental harassment and constant life threat being suffered by him due to the inaction and improper control of the increasing water level of the reservoir.
(ii) To pass necessary order, direction and writ thereby directing the respondent No.1 and 2 to Laik Ram vs The State Of H.P. And Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175296427/
1 acquire the land and house property of the petitioner in accordance with law and to grant compensation as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013."
2.

sentences.text:
Though, having regard to the nature of dispute and prayer made in the instant petition,
prima-facie this Court is of the view that present petition is not maintainable, however, having taken note of imminent danger to the property of the petitioner on account of construction of reservoir,
coupled with the fact that petitioner has already approached Deputy Commissioner, Shimla for redressal of his grievance, present petition is disposed of with a direction to Deputy Commissioner,
Shimla to take cognizance of the complaint dated 27.08.2022, if not already taken, expeditiously,
preferably within a period of ten days.
Needless to say, authority concerned while doing the needful in terms of instant order shall afford an opportunity of being heard to the petitioner and pass speaking order thereupon.

In the aforesaid terms, the present petition is disposed of .
alongwith pending applications, if any.
 (Sandeep Sharma),
 Judge  March 15, 2024  (shankar)
